jobs.description:
About Andercore 
 Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.
 We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.
 
 Where we are today:
 Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

 Seven European markets live

 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

 
 $40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.
 We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.
 
 About this role 
 We're hiring a Director Product Management to own a core product area end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and ship it yourself, reporting directly to the founder. 
  
 What you will own 
 A P&L-relevant product area (logistics automation, pricing, or embedded finance) from discovery to shipped outcomes

 Concrete targets, not vibes: we run on automation and retention metrics, and your area will have a number attached

 Discovery with real users: traders, logistics operators, and buyers, weekly and in person 

 Prioritization and delivery with your engineering squad, including the calls on what not to build

 Post-launch iteration driven by usage data and margin impact, not opinion

 What you bring 
 5+ years in product management with at least 2 at a B2B scale-up, owning a product area through significant growth

 Shipped products in an operations-heavy domain: logistics, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech, or similar

 Fluency with data: you pull your own numbers, define your own metrics, and change course when they tell you to

 A track record of fast MVP cycles: built, measured, iterated or killed, and you can walk us through the decisions

 Experience shipping AI-powered features to production is a strong plus

 Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement

 What this role is not 

 Not a people-management role on day one. You'll lead through the product, with a path to building a team as the org scales.

 Not a strategy-deck job. If your best work lives in slides rather than shipped product, this isn't the fit.

 Who you are 
 You are slef-motivated, iterating fast, and eager for product success

 You are a self-starter who takes ownership of a problem and makes sure it’s solved

 You are comfortable with giving and receiving feedback for continuous improvement

 A lifelong learner, someone who can dive into a domain quickly and become an expert

 Data-informed, business-oriented and relentless in execution

 
 We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Inbox)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

Impact & Team

Join the team working on the Mail & Calendar ecosystem alongside 50 Engineers

  • Current Projects:
    • Developing innovative productivity tools that seamlessly integrate with our privacy-centric ecosystem.
    • Advancing the frontiers of cryptography to ensure user data remains secure even in the face of emerging technologies such as quantum proof encryption.
    • Expanding Proton's reach into the B2B segment, bringing privacy and security to businesses worldwide.
    • Pushing the boundaries of innovation with projects like Scribe, the world's first private AI in a consumer product.
  • Impact Opportunities:
    • Own a big part of Mail & Calendar product development: Shape the future of products used by millions of people around the world.
    • Drive strategy: Independently influence the direction of Proton's flagship products and help us realize our vision of a private internet.
    • Be at the forefront of innovation: Work on groundbreaking projects that set new standards for privacy and security in the digital world.

What you will do:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the next stage in the evolution of some of our products (Proton Mail, Calendar). Product at Proton sits at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Data and Design. Your responsibility will be to grow user engagement and retention by creating remarkable user experiences for our community. You are versatile in product-led growth, at the heart of our freemium model.

  • Work with the senior leadership team to define a strategic vision and roadmap
  • Drive product innovation, develop novel, game-changing product features that expand our value proposition to new user segments and increase our defensibility.
  • Define and own what success looks like in terms of metrics such as active usage, user engagement, retention, and revenue.
  • Facilitate hand-in-hand collaboration between product, engineering, growth and marketing to align on the vision and the execution.
  • Lead the teams through execution from conception to delivery. Troubleshoot and solve problems involving multiple teams inside and outside of product and maintain high development velocity.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and gather customer feedback to inform product decisions.
  • Anticipate growth ceilings and define scaling strategies to prevent them, that include managing projects beyond pure-product work, and include foundational technology, tools, and processes, such as a customer engagement platform.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We're on a mission 
 Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
  
 We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
  
 This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.
  
 The role 
 You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
  
 You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
  
 The problems you'll own 
  
 Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.

 Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.

 Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.

 From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.

 The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.

 Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.

 Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.

  
 This could be for you if 
  
 You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.

 You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.

 You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.

 You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.

 You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.

 Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.

  
 What you'll get 
 You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.
 Competitive salary + up to £5,000 in share options 

 Private medical insurance

 Flexible, hybrid working

 28 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and up to 4 weeks a year working from anywhere

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
 Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
 We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.
 It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.
  
 Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
  
 Kraken  powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
  
 We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.
  
 It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.
  
 Today, energy communication is often reactive and fragmented. We see something better. Contextual. Intelligent. Proactive. Capable of guiding millions of households toward smarter, cleaner energy decisions whilst managing some of their most significant financial decisions. 
 Paired with the revolution of energy generation, this is a chance to shape how an industry shows up to the world.
 At Kraken, we are pioneering the transformative shift toward a fully autonomous, proactive customer experience, seamless across all channels, that detects friction, decides actions, and learns in real time before a customer even realises they need help. We enable our clients to offer a hyper-personalised service and over the next two years, we are embedding AI not as a collection of generic customer service surface-level features, but as the foundational connective network across the entire Kraken portfolio, harnessing ecosystem-wide data to fuel a flywheel of continuous product adoption and value.
 As a Senior / Staff Product Manager, you will redefine the standard for hyper-personalisation by deploying end-to-end self-service intelligence, shifting human agents from routine task executors to high-value specialists, and aligning our strategy around transforming the energy industry rather than static technical components.
 We are building an energy system of the future. An engagement engine that takes richer conversations to actionable insights to develop personalised marketing campaigns, operational system transformation, billing and payment lifecycle events; and over time, predictive, proactive customer experiences and offerings at a global scale. If we get this right, we help the acceleration towards a cleaner, greener, future 💚. 
 🚀 What you’ll own 
 

 Raising the bar for customer communication in energy 
 Energy providers often struggle with fragmented systems and reactive outreach. We see the opportunity to make communication:
 Contextual and personalized

 Predictive and proactive

 Delightful, even in regulated environments

 Building an adaptable and impact led agentic development framework for  world leading multi-channel engagement    
 You will lead the development and scaling of Kraken’s agentic offering across all customer engagement including voice, email, SMS, and other extensible future channels. You’ll be defining the future of Kraken’s client offering and experience as they undertake transformation of the energy operating model in personalised customer experience and measurable impact. 
 This is zero to one role with the expectation of scaling. You must be comfortable operating in ambiguity at the start and disciplined enough to simplify as complexity grows.
 You will define and own:
 Developing AI products clients can trust, end customers love and deliver tangible commercial value.

 Enriching and evolving Kraken’s core platforms as a result of new context and MCP capabilities, made possible by influencing enterprise roadmaps 

 Continually evolving user experience as a result of new AI products and features

 Architectural and product direction of knowledge and agentic design patterns

 The roadmap that balances foundational capability with forward-looking innovation

 What you’ll do in practice 
 You’ll own the development of customer AI products and partner closely with every team at Kraken—Product, Design, Engineering, and our leadership—to drive impact. As a core source of customer insight, you will influence the long-term roadmap while owning your portfolio of agents from end-to-end. Your day-to-day will involve:
 Designing enterprise-grade AI agents: Collaborate with strategic clients to understand their workflows, pain points, and goals, then build and optimise elegant solutions.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
 Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
 We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.
 It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.
 Kraken Utilities 
  
 Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 55 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027. Kraken is the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications. 
  
 We’re now charging the Kraken platform to other utility industries (Water and Broadband) and have created a new team called - Kraken Utilities. Over the last 3 years we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry wide problems within the water and broadband sectors (such as customer experience & water leak detection).
  
 The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase, and has already signed six key clients: Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo. We are currently 120+ people strong globally.
  
 At Kraken Technologies we’re looking to revolutionise the utilities industry to make basic services like power, water, and the internet cheaper, greener, and better for people around the world. Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 55 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027.
 Our Technology Team has grown extremely quickly as a result, tripling in size within the last 18 months. With this rapid growth and the strong backing of our leadership, we are entering an exciting phase of becoming increasingly product-led and value-driven. We operate in a complex enterprise software market with large, high-profile clients. Therefore, we need PMs with a dual mindset: the strategic vision to proactively discover and solve deep industry problems, coupled with the rigorous execution skills required to steer massive, business-critical client migrations onto our platform. We will give you the space to do  real product work, while trusting you to deliver on our most vital enterprise commitments.
 We operate with a high-trust, high-autonomy model. We are looking for a self-starter who thrives when given a complex problem and the freedom to solve it their way, working methodically to ensure projects go from inception to completion. You will act as the glue across multiple teams, putting the customer first and working empathetically to deliver the best possible solutions.
 About the team: 
 We’re currently providing licences of our platform to serve the water and broadband industries and have created a new team - Kraken Utilities. Over the last year, we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry-wide problems within these sectors (such as transforming customer experience & water leak detection software).
 The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase. We are currently 100+ people (engineers, product, implementation, design, strategy) supported by the 1500+ people in the wider Kraken world.
 This role will join as a Product Manager focused specifically on the water industry—working in a tight-knit team and collaborating closely with our engineering, implementation, and strategy groups.
 

 What you'll do: 
 

 Proactive Discovery: Act as a product-led PM. You won't just manage a backlog; you will proactively drive discovery, identify underlying customer problems, and figure out how to scale and grow your products to deliver massive value.

 Rigorous Delivery & Migrations: Balance your product vision with the realities of enterprise software. You will help steer significant migrations onto the Kraken platform, ensuring high-stakes, highly complex projects are delivered methodically and successfully for our clients.

 End-to-End Autonomy: You will be handed high-level business goals, not step-by-step instructions. You are expected to autonomously navigate ambiguity, prioritise your team's work, and drive solutions from initial inception to a successful rollout.

 Data-Driven Impact: Leverage data rigorously to spot new product opportunities and actively measure the impact of what your team delivers. You ensure we are building for measurable outcomes, not just shipping features.

 🏡 Where you'll fit in
 Why this role matters 
 
This role will focus on Kraken Distribution, our newest and fast-growing product line. We are looking for someone to help us grow Kraken Distribution's footprint by driving awareness, and figuring out product-market fit and the right go-to-market approach.

 About the role 

 
 Kraken Distribution is serving distribution network operators as they navigate the next phase of the energy transition. As networks face growing grid congestion, two-way energy flows, an increasing number of distributed energy resources (e.g., solar PVs, EVs, batteries) and much greater data complexity, Kraken Distribution helps utilities modernise how they plan, operate, and evolve their networks - enabling smarter, more flexible, and more customer-centric grids.
  
 🚀 What you’ll own 
 Product Strategy & Commercialisation:  
 Help figure out product-market fit for Distribution across target markets

 Identify market opportunities and customer needs to influence product strategy and monetisation for Distribution

 Develop positioning and messaging for European markets

 Help drive adoption of Distribution 
 Drive analyst engagement and help communicate our product vision and market differentiation

 Develop thought leadership and customer-facing content that builds awareness and credibility in the market

 Partner with Sales to develop the pipeline

 Work closely with the marketing team on ABM programs and event messaging

 Be the voice of the market 
 Build a strong understanding of customer needs, market trends and competitors

 Bring customer insights into product and go-to-market discussions

 Help ensure that commercial decisions are grounded in customer and market evidence

 
 🧠 What you bring to the party 
 

 7+ years' experience in Product Marketing, Commercial Strategy, GTM Strategy, Product Management or Management Consulting.

 Experience defining go-to-market strategies for enterprise software or technology products.

 Strong strategic thinking and comfort working with ambiguity.

 The ability to turn market insight into practical product and commercial recommendations.

 ⭐️ Bonus points 
 Knowledge of European languages

 Experience in utilities

jobs.title: Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) - ADAM Audio GmbH
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) – ADAM Audio GmbH 
 Location: Berlin office / hybrid (Berlin preferred)
 Term: Full-time, permanent
 Salary: Depending on experience
 Start date: as soon as possible
 Travel: Up to 20% (trade shows, studio visits, JDM/ODM partners)
 Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
 Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
 Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?
 We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.
 Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.
 Role and responsibilities: 
 You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
 You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
 Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
 You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
 You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About Typeform

Typeform helps people create better conversations at scale.

Millions of people use Typeform to collect information, understand their customers, generate leads, run research, gather feedback, and power workflows across their businesses.

We are continuing to evolve Typeform from a form builder into a broader platform for collecting, understanding, and acting on information. AI is becoming a major part of that direction, both through experiences we build for customers and through making Typeform easier for AI agents and other products to interact with.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape what comes next.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Typeform, you will own a meaningful product area and work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Research, Marketing, and other teams to turn customer problems and business opportunities into products people genuinely want to use.

You will be responsible for understanding the problem space, setting product direction, deciding where the team should focus, and helping the team move from insight to execution.

This is not a role where Product simply writes requirements and hands them to Engineering.

We expect our Product Managers to be close to customers, opinionated about the problems worth solving, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and able to bring teams together around a clear direction.

You will balance customer value, product quality, technical considerations, and commercial impact while helping the team move quickly and learn.

What you will do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a key area of the Typeform product.
  • Build a strong understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the problems they are trying to solve.
  • Identify opportunities through customer conversations, behavioural data, research, market insight, and product intuition.
  • Turn broad problems into clear product bets, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Design and Engineering from discovery through delivery.
  • Work with Data and Research to understand customer behaviour and evaluate whether what we build is working.
  • Make thoughtful prioritisation decisions across customer needs, business goals, technical investment, and product quality.
  • Define success measures and use them to guide product decisions before and after launch.
  • Run experiments where appropriate and use the results to shape future product direction.
  • Work with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other teams to ensure we understand the wider customer and commercial context.
  • Communicate product direction clearly and build alignment across teams and leadership.
  • Help teams move from ideas to shipped experiences without losing sight of the original customer problem.
  • Look beyond individual features and think about how your product area contributes to the wider Typeform platform.
  • Explore how AI can improve the customer experience, change existing workflows, and create new ways for customers to get value from Typeform.

What we are looking for

  • You have significant experience building and scaling digital products, ideally within SaaS, product led growth, collaboration software, productivity tools, or another strong product environment.
  • Comfortable taking on messy, ambiguous product problems and bringing structure and direction to them.
  • A strong focus on customer problems and outcomes, rather than jumping straight to features.
  • Strong product judgement, with the ability to use customer insight, data, and context to make good decisions.
  • Close collaboration with Engineering and Design, with product development treated as a shared discipline.
  • Able to set a clear product direction while staying practical about what the team should focus on next.
  • Confident making trade offs, making decisions, and explaining the thinking behind them.
  • Good judgement around when to experiment, when to research, and when there is enough evidence to move forward.
  • Clear communication, with the ability to adapt complex ideas for different audiences.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions can influence activation, engagement, retention, expansion, and revenue.
  • Curiosity about AI and how it is changing the way products are built and how customers interact w

jobs.title: Product Owner / Manager – DEXIOS SaaS-Plattform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!

 Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung 
 Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
 Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
 Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
 Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
 TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik 
 Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
 Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
 Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
 UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten 
 Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
 Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
 Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
 KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt 
 Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
 Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
 Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
 TEAM – Schnittstellen 
 Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
 Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
 Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
 PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset  
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
 Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
 KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
 Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
 Was diese Rolle nicht ist 
 Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
 Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
 Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
 Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
 

 Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
 Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
 KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
 Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
 Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Ur

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 
  • It’s a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.  
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you’ll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (IntelliJ Scala Plugin)

jobs.title: Group Product Manager [Klaxoon]
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Klaxoon — the product area responsible for Wrike’s visual collaboration strategy and the evolution of whiteboarding experiences within the broader CWM platform.

In this role, you will define and lead the strategy of Wrike Whiteboards across the key pillars: whiteboard core experience, AI strategy, vertical-oriented use cases, convergence between Wrike and Klaxoon, and customer retention. You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration. You will help transform Klaxoon into a world-class visual collaboration tool while developing the PM team into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Define and drive the Klaxoon strategy: Set the vision, priorities, and roadmap for Klaxoon across the core whiteboard experience, AI strategy, vertical differentiation, and Wrike/Klaxoon convergence into a single seamless product.
  • Grow whiteboard adoption and experience: Continuously raise the bar on the Klaxoon product experience to make it a world-class visual collaboration tool, with strong focus on driving adoption among Wrike customers and identifying high-value vertical use cases.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to work AI-natively, identifying where agentic workflows can change how the team operates and scales output.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers - helping them move from feature ownership to strategic product leadership while building a shared product culture across Wrike and Klaxoon.

Your qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, positioning, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer expectations, product convergence, innovation, and long-term strategic direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • AI-native thinking: Practical understanding of AI-native product strategy and ability to identify differentiated AI use cases in visual collaboration.
  • Good UX judgment: Ability to balance product power, simplicity, adoption, and customer experience in collaborative tools.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in visual collaboration, whiteboarding, CWM, work management, or team collaboration products.
  • Practical understanding of agentic workflows and AI-native product development.
  • Proficiency in French is a strong plus - the team is mostly France-based.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex product areas for the AI-native future.

About the Role:

  • Visual collaboration impact: You will shape the future of Klaxoon as a world-class whiteboarding and visual collaboration experience inside Wrike.
  • Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing adoption, AI, vertical strategy, customer retention, product convergence, and innovation in one highly visible product area.
  • AI-native transformation: You will help define how visual collaboration evolves in a future where AI changes

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Propulsion System (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission: 
 As Project Manager – Propulsion System, you will lead the development and integration of VÆRIDION's electric propulsion system for next-generation electric aircraft. You will manage cross-functional activities across engineering, testing, certification, manufacturing, and supply chain to ensure propulsion system milestones are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with programme and airworthiness requirements.
  
 Your Day-to-Day: 
 Lead the end-to-end propulsion system project from concept through certification and industrialisation

 Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource forecasts

 Coordinate propulsion system design, development, testing, and integration activities across internal teams and suppliers

 Drive technical reviews, programme milestones, risk management, and change control processes

 Track technical maturity, project performance, and key deliverables against programme objectives

 Manage external partners and suppliers, ensuring delivery to scope, schedule, quality, and cost targets

 Facilitate alignment between propulsion, systems, certification, manufacturing, and supply chain teams

 Support verification, validation, and certification activities for the propulsion system

 Proactively identify and resolve technical, programme, and organisational risks

 Provide clear status reporting and decision support to leadership and stakeholders

  
 Your Profile: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related field

 Several years of project management experience in aerospace, aviation, automotive, or another safety-critical industry

 Proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary engineering development projects

 Strong understanding of systems engineering, product development, verification, and configuration management

 Experience coordinating internal stakeholders, suppliers, and external development partners

 Excellent planning, communication, risk management, and stakeholder management skills

 Knowledge of electric propulsion, powertrain, high-voltage, or aerospace systems is desirable

 Familiarity with aerospace certification processes is advantageous

 Fluent in English; German is a plus

 Proficiency with project management and product lifecycle management tools

 We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. 
  
 Why us? 
 Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

 We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

 Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

 Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

 Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

 Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

 Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

 Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

 Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

 Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

 Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Ground Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief 

We deliver the half of the rocket that stays on the ground. As Senior Project Manager in the Ground Systems department at Isar Aerospace, you will be managing the establishment and deployment of mid- to large-scale test and launch facilities. Situated in Munich, you will be playing a key role in managing the project from the initiation, over all engineering phases, through construction and commissioning until handing over to the on-site operations crew. The multidisciplinary team you will be working with consists of highly motivated engineers with an international background, fulfilling technical and co-ordinational roles in the project. You will coordinate timeline, costs, risks and top-level requirements with internal and external stakeholders, reporting to senior management.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Technically manage a multidisciplinary, cross-functional project team, covering multiple departments
  • Manage an international constellation of internal and external stakeholders including contract setup and negotiation
  • Be responsible for reporting on the project status to management regarding ambitious timelines, budgets and top-level risks of the project
  • Ability to identify, assess and mitigate technical, financial and operational risks early and proactively
  • Closely collaborate with our internal customers of the rocket systems, using your technical know-how to realise the project according to set scope and timeline
  • Contribute to the establishment of new sites for Isar Aerospace by working closely together with service departments
  • Setup and improve workflows, processes, structures where necessary, to expedite project execution in collaboration with team managers across departments

Qualification Checklist 

  • B. Sc. or M.Sc. degree in mechanical/ civil/ aerospace / chemical engineering or an equivalent qualification
  • About 5 years of relevant work experience in at least one of the following fields: systems engineering, project management, process plant, propulsion test bench or launch base design, and infrastructure/construction projects or similar
  • Experience working in and/or managing complex, international,  infrastructure/ process plant projects or similar
  • Experience of working in a regulatory environment, ideally internationally, to ensure Compliance, Safety and Certification of the facility
  • Knowledge of the project management toolkit to initiate, realise and close-out facility projects
  • Quick grasp of technical and managerial problems and ability to quickly conduct sound trade-offs
  • Reliable coordinator between stakeholders and engineers with confident demeanor, while keeping the project team motivated and unified
  • Willingness to travel internationally
  • English fluent

Bonus Skills

  • German language skills
  • Technical expertise in the aerospace sector, understanding of rocket launch systems and ground infrastructure of launch systems
  • Project management certification: PMI-PMP, AXELOS-PRINCE2, APM-PMQ, IPMA Level D/C or similar

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Public transport ticket: Commute with ease using a fully financed Deutschlandticket
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allow

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Software
jobs.description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid 

Salary: £68,000 to £84,000 DOE 

We will also consider part-time applications for this role. Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.  

 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. 

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast. 

 

About the role 

Deltakit is Riverlane’s open-source software development kit (SDK) for QEC which is designed to help researchers build, test and run QEC workflows as the field of quantum computing rapidly evolves. 

You’ll sit right at the heart of Deltakit, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most. 

You’ll own and evolve Deltakit’s strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision. You’ll strike the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today, helping us build for the future of quantum computing while delivering value right now. 

Beyond the roadmap, you’ll play a key role in bringing Deltakit to life for the community. From supporting launches to engaging directly with users, you’ll shape how we show up, tell our story, and communicate the product’s value in a way that excites and inspires people to build with it.

 

What you will do

  • Engage with users, partners and the open-source community to gather insight and feedback 
  • Analyse product usage, developer behaviour and the broader ecosystem to inform priorities

jobs.title: Product Manager (Data) - Fluent French & English
jobs.description:
Job Title: Product Manager (Data)

Location: London, Bristol or Paris (Hybrid - 3 days in office)

Team: Data Products

Reporting To: Director of Product

This role is based in London, Bristol or Paris and requires existing right to work in the UK or France.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As the Product Manager for Data Product Implementation, your primary responsibility is to successfully lead the data products rollout for a key Kaluza client. You will work closely with engineers and experts in the Kaluza Data Product team, other Kaluza domain Implementation leads, and relevant client subject-matter experts to ensure that our data model and products are localised to meet our client's needs.

Responsibilities include:
  • Client Engagement: Articulate Kaluza data products and data models to our key clients.
  • Requirements & Roadmap: Document and translate client requirements for data products and align them with the global product roadmap priorities.
  • Development Support: Support development by refining and prioritising backlog items and work with software engineers to deliver solutions that drive value for clients.
  • Product Adoption: Drive product adoption through the creation of technical documentation, release communications, and delivering training sessions for client stakeholders.
  • Domain Integration: Gain a broad understanding of various Kaluza Product areas—Billing & Payments, Customer Care, Energy Commerce and Energy Optimisation—and how data products can unlock value in each.
  • Data Model Contribution: Be a key contributor to Kaluza's global data model with the potential to own its extension and maintenance for all clients.
  • Metrics & Culture: Work with the team to build and measure the right metrics for product success and nurture a culture of learning from data.
  • Communication: Radiate information, improve transparency and communicate effectively to internal and external audiences.
About You

Ideally you'll have/be:
  • Technical Experience: 3+ years experience as an agile Product Manager working on data platforms/products.
  • Rollout Experience: Experience supporting large-scale enterprise product rollouts, especially on "edge" / localised deployments of a global product.
  • Stakeholder Management: You excel at managing stakeholders, with the ability to value and juggle competing priorities and influence decisions at all levels of the organisation.
  • Communication Skills: You excel at written and visual communication to both technical and commercial audiences.
  • Problem Solver: You are a patient and tenacious problem solver who is willing to roll up their sleeves to learn and understand a domain despite limited knowledge or experience in it.
  • Collaborative Nature: You are a team player who embraces collaboration and knowledge sharing within your team and across different teams.
What will set you apart
  • Language Skills: A strong preference for a French speaker to support our implementations with key global clients.
  • Adaptability: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where fast iteration and experimentation are the norm.
  • Global Vision: The opportunity to own and extend our global data, shaped by your implementation experience.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Data Platform)
jobs.description:
Technical Product Manager (Data Platform)

Location: London

Office requirement: Hybrid, 2x week

Employment type: Permanent

At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to play a key role in our Data Product team in London. If that’s you, and solving complex technical problems at scale gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.


Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔

As our Technical Product Manager, you’ll sit within the Process pillar of the Data Product Team and own the evolution of our next-generation data platform.

You’ll help shape the strategy and lead on the execution of how we ingest, process, validate, govern, and deliver high-quality consumer survey data at scale. This includes accelerating our migration from legacy pipelines into our modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow/Astronomer), while ensuring near-zero disruption to client delivery.

This role is critical to GWI’s future. Our Data Platform underpins everything we deliver to customers — from SaaS insights to APIs and AI integrations. Your work will directly impact how quickly new surveys reach clients, how reliably our data performs at scale, and how efficiently our internal teams operate.

Specifically, you will:

👉 Shape and execute the roadmap for scalable, automated survey processing on our Data Platform
👉 Reduce time from survey completion to client availability through workflow automation, validation frameworks, and release optimisation
👉 Lead migration from legacy pipelines to NDP, sequencing change to deliver early impact while maintaining delivery stability
👉 Partner deeply with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Research, and Data Operations teams to translate complex pipeline needs into robust platform capabilities
👉 Champion observability, data quality, lineage, and governance-by-design (including GDPR compliance and consent traceability)
👉 Balance technical excellence with commercial impact, ensuring platform investments unlock measurable client and business value

It’s also fun; we’re modernising core infrastructure in a live, revenue-critical environment. You’ll need to be comfortable making high-stakes prioritisation decisions, navigating legacy complexity, and leading through change as we scale.

What do I need to bring with me? 🧳

You’ll need to demonstrate strong product capabilities in technical, data-intensive environments. This is a role with significant architectural and organisational influence.

Here’s what the team will be looking for:

👉 Product management experience in data platforms, data infrastructure, or highly technical B2B environments.
👉 Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing data modelling, orchestration (e.g. Airflow), transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), APIs, and platform architecture trade-offs.
👉 Experience working with modern data technologies such as Bigquery, Airflow, Astronomer.
👉 Ability to write technical user stories, with clear technical requirements and data contracts.
👉 Demonstrable experience working with Data Engineers.

👉Confident stakeholder management across engineering, research, operations, and leadership.

👉 Experience owning or contributing to platform migrations or large-scale architectural evolution is a plus.

Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, exemplified by our leadership team, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.

 

What We Offer 🧘

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

  • Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
  • Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.
  • Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.
  • Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
  • Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
  • Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving

jobs.title: Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

 You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 

 The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.

 Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

 Our humble expectations 

 You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

 
 Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products

 Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.

 Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.

 Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

 High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.

 Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.

 Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.

 Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

 
 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About the role: What's in the Box

As the Senior Product Manager II for Menu Planning within the Operations Mega Alliance, you will own the product layer that decides what lands on HelloFresh menus every week, across markets, brands, and millions of customers. You will drive the systems and workflows that let our culinary, commercial, and operations teams plan, version, and scale an ever-expanding menu, working back from their needs to build the automation and data foundations that make a larger and more personalized assortment possible. 

This is a domain in the middle of a significant platform transformation: you will help move menu planning into a smarter baseline, all while keeping weekly menu delivery running without disruption. You will partner closely with engineering, culinary, procurement, and stakeholders across our largest markets to define a data-driven roadmap, untangle real complexity around regionality and menu customization, and set the long-term vision for how HelloFresh builds its menu at scale.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for menu planning, turning the needs of culinary, commercial, and operations partners into prioritized initiatives tied to clear business impact.
  • Build scalable systems and data foundations for menu versioning, regionality, and customization that make a larger, more personalized assortment possible.
  • Leverage AI and machine learning to automate menu and editorial workflows and sharpen assortment decisions, partnering with data science to take models from concept to production.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders across our largest markets to gather requirements, align in direction, and secure buy-in for strategic bets.
  • Apply a data-driven approach, using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and measure outcomes.
  • Champion product craft as the hands-on expert for menu planning, raising the bar on discovery, prioritization, and execution across the tribe.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

  • Seasoned product experience building and scaling technical or platform products, ideally in a domain with real operational or supply-chain complexity.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, shaping strategy in undefined problem spaces without waiting for a predefined solution.
  • Data-driven decision-making, comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and prove impact.
  • Fluency working alongside engineers, designers and data people, enough to understand technical trade-offs, feasibility, and how AI and machine learning can be applied to real workflows.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with a knack for aligning and influencing partners at every level and steering cross-functional teams toward shared goals.
  • Proven knack for structure, breaking multifaceted problems into parts others can act on.

What we offer

  • You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
  • Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
  • Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
  • Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.
  • Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
  • Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.
  • Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
  • We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience:

 SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings.
 Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life.
 
 About the role 
 As an Implementation Project Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring customers successfully adopt the SFG20 platform, enabling them to realise value quickly and confidently.
 By combining project management expertise with hands-on implementation delivery, you will guide customers from project initiation through to go-live. You will deliver a high-quality onboarding experience, manage implementation projects of varying complexity, and coordinate internal resources to ensure implementations are delivered efficiently, on time, and to a consistently high standard. Your work directly contributes to customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term success.

 Customer Implementation & Delivery

 Deliver implementation activities in line with agreed project plans, timelines and quality standards.

 Conduct customer workshops, implementation meetings and progress updates throughout the project lifecycle.

 Support customers with onboarding activities, system adoption and transition to Business as Usual.

 Ensure implementation documentation is completed and maintained accurately.

 Project Management 
 Manage multiple customer implementation projects simultaneously, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timescales and budget where applicable.

 Develop and maintain project plans, monitor milestones and proactively manage project risks and issues.

 Coordinate activities across internal teams including Customer Success, Product, Sales and Technical teams.

 Provide regular project reporting and communicate progress clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

 Escalate project risks appropriately and drive resolution to maintain successful project delivery.

 Resource Planning & Capacity Management 
 Support the planning and scheduling of implementation activities across the Implementation team and wider business.

 Continuous Improvement 
 Contribute to the ongoing improvement of implementation processes, tools and documentation.

 Identify opportunities to improve customer onboarding efficiency and project delivery.

 Share best practice and lessons learned across the team.

 Customer Experience 
 Build trusted relationships with customers, acting as a key point of contact throughout implementation.

 Deliver a professional, consultative customer experience that reflects SFG20's values.

 Understand customer requirements and translate these into successful implementation outcomes.

 Work collaboratively to maximise customer satisfaction and successful adoption of the SFG20 platform.

 
 Essential experience 
 Experience within Facilities Management, Building Maintenance or Compliance sectors.

 Excellent customer-facing communication and relationship management skills.

 Strong project planning and organisational skills.

 Experience implementing SaaS or cloud-based software solutions.

 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation, validation and analysis.

 Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously

 Comfortable presenting to customers and facilitating workshops.

 Familiarity with data migration or system configuration activities.
 

 Desirable experience 
 Project Management qualification (PRINCE2, APM, Agile, PMP or equivalent).

 Experience contributing to process improvement initiatives.

 Experience supporting resource planning or capacity management.

jobs.description:

 At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.
 Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.
 We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.
 No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

 · Demonstrated experience owning a product area with meaningful technical complexity (integrations, platform, or infrastructure-adjacent products)

 · Strong analytical mindset -comfortable with metrics, funnel analysis, and data-informed prioritisation
 · Familiarity with compliance / regulatory constraints in product decisions (a plus, given the company formation and compliance context)
 · Experience mentoring or providing product leadership to others
